subject: ROUNDED phrase
notes: kb/Work PB1196 LANDED (w61e), PB3990 LANDED (w20261740a). Rule 7 keeps the resultant whether or not checking is enabled (cite.py OK §14.7.4.3 7)). Every final transfer asks it in its own rounding decision and raises CobolSizeError.ProhibitedInexact (EC-SIZE-TRUNCATION) before a value exists to store: the scaled carrier's CobolNum.BumpsMagnitude (RoundDiv, Rescale, Store, RescaleStoreCap, Divide, LandQuotient, CobolFloat.TryExactScaled, CobolIntrinsics.FromDouble), the SDIDI's CobolDec.RoundFromRemainder (ToUnscaled, MulAtScale, CobolWide.ToUnscaled), FloatResultant's unchecked entries and CobolEdit.FormatFloatStore; a Try form (TryStore, TryStoreU, FloatResultant.TryFrom*, TryFormatFloat) answers false. Under a SIZE ERROR phrase or EC-SIZE checking the statement's own catch sets the flag; with neither, ArithmeticEmitter.KeepsOnProhibitedInexact catches that condition alone around the PROHIBITED receiver's compute-and-store, so the receiver is unchanged and execution continues (DOC-A.1-70; GnuCOBOL 3.2 keeps it too). Re-probed (w20261740a): COMPUTE D5 ROUNDED MODE IS PROHIBITED = V (V 1.5, D5 PIC 99 VALUE 7, no phrase) stored 01 in every usage on main and terminated the run unit under STANDARD-DECIMAL; now 07 in both lanes, every receiver category (DISPLAY, COMP, COMP-5, COMP-3, Z9, Z9.9, COMP-1, +9.9E+99) and statement (COMPUTE, DIVIDE GIVING, MULTIPLY GIVING, ADD TO). Replaced: PB1196's unchecked truncation, DivideOrThrow, PB654's StoreArith gate (CobolFloat.InexactAtScale). ⚠ DETERMINATION (CONFORMANCE.md DOC-A.1-123): under native arithmetic an expression whose resultants are all floating-point evaluates in binary64, and that binary64 intermediate IS the arithmetic value the mode rounds; a binary64 resultant therefore holds it unchanged (COMPUTE D1 ROUNDED MODE IS TOWARD-GREATER = 1 / 3 equals the TOWARD-LESSER result), while an exact scaled/SDIDI value is rounded into either format once.
